- Read the Yan <> Sam Granola call (12 Oct) and Sam's "Riverbanks - Compilation Pages" deck,
  which has four pages: cover, whirlpool epigraph, prologue cover, epilogue cover. Mapped
  each edit onto Compilation Lo Res.
- Download modal (`2026-10-13_download-modal`, 56fbb19): Export now opens a dialog for PDF
  or PNG, the paper size (Original / B5 / A4 / A5, each page fitted and centred) and the
  watermark, with a new discreet Edge style as the default. The first build's Download did
  nothing in the agent's Chrome: the tab was hidden, and Chrome holds back a dialog's `close`
  event in a hidden tab. Download now finishes in the submit handler instead. Checked B5
  PDFs from headless Chrome. e2e not run (the local Supabase port clash again).
- Compilation edits via a background agent. It got partway, then the permission check
  blocked `add_page` / `add_free_panel` on the shared comic. The epilogue cover is placed and
  Act Four is renamed Gross Deliciousness Index. Act One needs no change: it already opens
  on "What, my fellow planetizens". The cover and prologue-cover pages exist but are still
  empty. The whirlpool and the move of the old cover are not done.
